decision.summary: A single candidate temporary offset in N (with correlated E/U) begins at index 485 and persists through 495. The offset is sustained and multi-sample, but no opposing return is observed within the allowed context [450,530]; thus status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported by the original observations in this region.

intervals.observation: N-component shows sustained positive offset (+2 to +4 MAD) from index 485 onward; E and U show correlated smaller excursions. No return observed within allowed context (450–530); onset is abrupt over ~5 samples, but interior is sustained without reversal. Return not confirmed before end of context.
